statement: The feat-18 scope is real in the baseline at every declared DTR coordinate: the prepare-implementation template still defaults the gate to 0.6, the engine enforces no 0.85 floor and grants green at any configured value, the Hypothesis domain type and ledger schema carry no justification, Main emits only a one-line verdict with no per-stage ledger report or cumulative history, and no check-hypothesis-report.py tool exists. All four changes are therefore net-new work rather than already-present behaviour.
